You are building new functionality. Treat the goal below as the full objective — implement it end-to-end, including the parts not explicitly called out but implied (tests, wiring into existing UI/state, updating docs where load-bearing).

Goal: Actions Dropwn in EPIC Queue

It should have New Epic or Run Build (there is no need to split) the run Bill in two actions

Simplified the Epic Queue's Actions dropdown to exactly two items — **+ New Epic** and **Run Build** — removing the third "Build Project (discuss first)" entry and its `handleAdvanced`/pending-draft plumbing in `EpicQueue.tsx`. Updated `EpicQueue.test.tsx` to match (dropped the two discuss-first tests, renamed remaining assertions to "Run Build"). Typecheck and all affected unit tests pass.
ok, comit to git if you are happy with the simplicity of implementation

Both files are byte-identical to HEAD — the Actions-menu simplification (New Epic + Run Build only) is already committed, folded into `92280db` on this branch. There's nothing left uncommitted for this change, so no new commit is needed.

Everything else in `git status` (scheduler state, project-brief, etc.) is unrelated pre-existing local state from other in-flight work — not part of this task, so I left it alone.

**Summary:** The EpicQueue Actions-dropdown simplification is already committed (part of `92280db`, working tree clean for those files). No commit action was needed this turn.
